title: P0: Pagination controls become visible after a trace search
verifies: the count query gates pagination visibility so the count badge and pagination toolbar render after a search on a populated stream

title: P0: Clicking page 2 replaces page-1 rows without leaving stale rows
verifies: the hasWritten fix swaps the grid to page-2 rows with no page-1 residue (replace, not append)

title: P1: Next and Prev buttons navigate pages and swap content
verifies: the prev/next buttons drive the same replace-semantics page change and restore page-1 rows on return

title: P1: Changing rows-per-page re-queries and resets to page 1
verifies: navigating to page 2 then changing rows-per-page resets currentPage back to page 1 (page-2 button deactivates), re-queries with the new size, and renders at most that many rows

title: P2: Single page shows pagination with prev/next disabled
verifies: a single-page result renders pagination with both prev and next disabled

title: P2: Zero results hide pagination and show the no-results state
verifies: a zero-result search keeps pagination hidden and renders the no-results state
